Discord.title: Albion Online Discord bot
Discord.metaDescription: Add the {siteName} Discord bot to post guild kills, deaths, and battles. Sign in with Discord, invite it from your account, and set tracking in the browser.
Discord.description: The bot posts a tracked Albion guild’s new kills, deaths, and large battles into Discord channels you choose — kill snapshots, battle recap images, and links back to {siteName}.
Discord.inviteUnavailable: The public invite link is not configured yet. Check back soon, or ask the site operator for the bot invite.
Discord.setupIntro: Sign in with Discord, invite the bot from your account, then pick a guild and channels. You need Manage Server on that Discord server.
Discord.setupSignInBody: Create an AOTracker account with Discord, or link Discord to one you already have. Then open <notificationsLink>Discord Notifications</notificationsLink>.
Discord.setupInviteBody: Pick a Discord server you administer. If the bot is not there yet, invite it. Approve view channel, send messages, embed links, attach files, use application commands, and read message history.
Discord.setupTrackTitle: 3. Track a guild and set notifications
Discord.setupTrackBody: Search a guild already on AOTracker. Set kills, deaths, and battle channels, then filters and an optional ping role. New fights post automatically; older ones are not backfilled.
Discord.commandsIntro: You can do the same setup in Discord. Type / and fill in the options. Anyone can run lookup commands. Only Manage Server can change tracking, channels, filters, or ping roles.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.description: Bind a guild and set kill, death, battle, and live channels. Manage Server required.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Filter which fights post and optionally ping a role. Manage Server required.

lookups.title: Lookups
lookups.description: Anyone in the server can run these.

track.summary: Bind one Albion guild to this Discord server. Replaces a previous /track.
track.detail: Pick the region first, then start typing the guild name and select it from autocomplete. The guild must already appear on AOTracker. This creates kills, deaths, and battle notifications; channels are still unset until you run the channel commands.

killsChannel.summary: Channel that receives posts when the tracked guild gets a kill.
killsChannel.detail: Choose a text or announcement channel. Run /track first. Use a dedicated #kills channel so deaths stay separate.

deathsChannel.summary: Channel that receives posts when a tracked-guild member dies.
deathsChannel.detail: Same as /kills-channel, for deaths. Friendly-fire (same guild on both sides) posts here only.

battlesChannel.summary: Channel that receives a battle recap image when enough of the tracked guild’s players are in a fight.
battlesChannel.detail: Choose a text or announcement channel. Run /track first. The bot waits until the Albion board stops changing, then posts one recap image per battle that meets the minimum guild-player threshold. Optional thread-per-battle is set on Discord Notifications or with /feed-filters.

liveChannel.summary: Channel that receives a ping when a linked guild member goes live on Twitch playing Albion Online.
liveChannel.detail: Choose a text or announcement channel. Run /track first. Admins attach Twitch channels to player profiles; the bot posts only when that player’s current guild is the tracked guild.

untrack.summary: Stop posting kills, deaths, battles, and live pings in this server.
untrack.detail: Removes guild kill, death, battle, and live notifications. The bot stays in the server. Run /track again to start over. Does not delete old Discord messages.

status.summary: Show the bound Albion guild and which channels are set.
status.detail: Anyone in the server can run this. Use it to confirm setup after /track and the channel commands.

feedFilters.summary: Limit which kills, deaths, or battles the bot posts.
feedFilters.detail: Use feed:kills, feed:deaths, or feed:battles to change one notification, or omit feed to update all. For battles, set min-players (tracked guild players in the fight) and create-thread. Use 0 fame/silver for any, and omit content or use all for every fight size. Manage Server required.

pingRole.summary: Mention a role on kill, death, or battle posts.
pingRole.detail: Optional. Use clear:true to stop pinging. feed can be kills, deaths, battles, or both. Battle pings fire on the recap post. Manage Server required.

whoami.summary: Show the Albion character claimed on your AOTracker account.
whoami.detail: Looks up this Discord user on AOTracker. If you have claimed a character, you get the name, region, and profile link. Ephemeral — only you see it.

lookup.summary: Get an AOTracker profile link for a player or guild.
lookup.detail: The player or guild must already exist on AOTracker. Start typing the name and pick from autocomplete. Ephemeral.

feud.summary: Link to the feud page for two guilds.
feud.detail: Both guilds must already exist on AOTracker. Ephemeral.

watchlistAdd.summary: Add an entity to your AOTracker watchlist.
watchlistAdd.detail: Requires a site account signed in with this Discord user. Rate-limited. Ephemeral — never posted to the channel.

filters.title: Build a filter command
filters.description: Slash-command helper. Discord Notifications has the same filters in the browser.

Discord.postsBody: Each qualifying kill or death is one Discord message: a snapshot image with killer and victim gear, inventory, item power, kill fame, and estimated silver, plus link buttons for the killer, victim, and the full kill page on {siteName}. Zero-fame events are skipped. Large battles post one recap image after the fight settles, with a link to the battle page.
Discord.note: Anyone can follow any Albion guild. You need Manage Server to configure the bot.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: {siteName} (“we”, “our”) provides Albion Online kill and profile tracking. This page explains what information we handle when you use the site.

sections.informationBody: We store and display publicly available Albion Online game data such as player names, guilds, alliances, kill events, and battle statistics retrieved from third-party game APIs. You can browse the site without creating an account or providing personal contact details.
sections.accountsBody1: Signing in is optional. When available, you may create a site account by signing in with Discord or Google. We use this to keep you signed in and to sync your watchlist and recent searches across devices.
sections.accountsBody2: If you sign in with Discord, we request Discord’s identify permission and the list of Discord servers you belong to (guilds). We use the server list only to show Discord notification settings for servers where you have Manage Server. We store your Discord user ID, username, and avatar (if available), plus session data needed to keep you signed in. We do not request Discord’s email permission and we do not collect, receive, or store your Discord email address.
sections.accountsBody3: If you sign in with Google, Google may provide your name, profile image, and email address, which we store to operate your account. Sign-in with Google is separate from Discord; choosing Discord does not share your Discord email with us.
sections.accountsBody4: You can link or unlink Discord and Google on the same site account from Account settings when both providers are available (at least one sign-in method must remain). You can review active sessions, export a copy of your synced watchlist and recent searches, clear that synced data, or delete your account and associated sign-in data, from Account settings. Operator/admin tooling and scheduled jobs are separate from your personal account preferences.
sections.logsBody1: Our hosting provider may automatically collect standard request logs (for example IP address, user agent, and pages requested) for security, reliability, and performance. We do not sell personal information.
sections.logsBody2: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand aggregate traffic and how pages are used (for example page views, approximate location, device type, and referrers). Google may set cookies or use similar technologies and process this data according to <googlePrivacyLink>Google's Privacy Policy</googlePrivacyLink>. You can limit analytics cookies through your browser settings or Google's opt-out tools.
sections.cookiesBody1: The site may use cookies or similar technologies required for basic operation, by our hosting platform, by Google Analytics (when enabled), or to maintain your signed-in session. We may also store your preferred region in a cookie so server-rendered pages match your choice. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
sections.cookiesBody2: Theme preference and, when you are not signed in, search autocomplete, your watchlist, and related preferences may be stored in your browser's local storage on your device. When you are signed in, we store your watchlist, recent searches, and preferred feed region on our servers so they sync across devices. Theme preference stays on your device. When you filter kills by watchlist or open the watchlist activity page, the Albion entity IDs in your watchlist are sent to our servers to run that request.
sections.thirdPartyBody: Links to Albion Online, Discord, Google, or other external sites are provided for convenience. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies. Sign-in with Discord or Google is also subject to those providers’ terms and privacy policies.
sections.discordBotBody: If a Discord server administrator adds our bot and configures kill or death feeds, we store the Discord server ID, channel IDs, the tracked Albion guild, optional feed filters, and optionally the Discord user ID of whoever ran the setup command. We use this only to post notifications containing publicly available game data. We do not read general message content from your Discord server. Bot setup is separate from signing in to a site account.
sections.contactBody: If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to request changes regarding your data, use <accountLink>Account settings</accountLink> when signed in, or visit our <contactLink>contact page</contactLink> for ways to reach us, including our Discord community.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These terms govern your use of {siteName} (“we”, “our”). By using the site, Discord bot, or related services, you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use {siteName}.

sections.serviceBody: {siteName} is a fan-made Albion Online PvP tracker. We display publicly available game data such as kills, battles, leaderboards, and profiles. The service is provided free of charge and may change or stop at any time.
sections.accountsBody: Signing in is optional. If you create an account (for example with Discord or Google), you are responsible for activity on that account. You may delete your account from Account settings. We may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms.
sections.useBody: Use {siteName} only in a lawful way. Do not attempt to disrupt the service, overload it, bypass access controls, scrape in a way that harms the site or game APIs, impersonate others, or use the Discord bot in servers you are not allowed to manage.
sections.dataBody: Kill feeds, stats, loot values, and related figures come from third-party game APIs and our own processing. They can be delayed, incomplete, or wrong. Do not treat {siteName} as an official source for gameplay, disputes, or bans.
sections.discordBotBody: If you add our bot to a Discord server, you represent that you have permission to do so. You are responsible for which channels it posts to and for following Discord’s terms. We may stop posting or remove bot access if it is misused.
sections.ipBody: Albion Online names, artwork, and related materials belong to Sandbox Interactive GmbH. {siteName} is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Albion Online or Sandbox Interactive GmbH. You may not copy our site, branding, or content for a competing service without permission.
sections.disclaimerBody: {siteName} is provided “as is.” We do not warrant that the site or bot will be accurate, available, or error-free. To the fullest extent allowed by law, we are not liable for losses arising from your use of the service, including missed kills, incorrect stats, or downtime.
sections.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will change when we do. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
sections.contactBody: Questions about these terms can go through our <contactLink>contact page</contactLink>. How we handle personal data is described in the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
